name: Tillet Custom Fabrication
old_description: Welcome to Tillet Custom Fabrication, your trusted and reliable source for all your metal fabrication needs. I provide quality workmanship and exceptional customer service in the Madison, WI area. Contact me today for a free quote.
about:
Tillet Custom Fabrication operates from Middleton, Wisconsin, in the Madison metropolitan area. The business is run by Gabriel, who serves as the primary fabricator and point of contact. No founding year is publicly disclosed, and the ownership structure is not specified beyond the sole-proprietor presentation.

The shop provides a broad range of custom metal fabrication and machining services. Capabilities include CNC plasma cutting, tube bending, welding (including cast iron and exotic metals), and general machining. Work spans marine repairs such as pontoon and skeg restoration, automotive components like custom exhaust systems, turbo kits, roll cages, and brackets, as well as residential and commercial projects including ADA-compliant railings, custom furniture, bistro lighting fixtures, and mailboxes. The shop also produces aerospace-grade vacuum-insulated piping for cryogenic liquids, solar panel frames and mounts, beavertail boat pods, and trailer repairs.

Customers come from marine, automotive, residential, aerospace, solar, and general manufacturing sectors. Examples include boat owners needing pontoon repairs, automotive enthusiasts seeking custom exhaust and turbo components, homeowners and contractors requiring code-compliant railings and custom metal furniture, and aerospace or cryogenic projects requiring specialized piping.

The company emphasizes transparent pricing with upfront estimates, constant communication throughout the project, and free quotes. Gabriel highlights expertise in aluminum, stainless steel, and exotic metals as a core differentiator.
